description: Fuse bursts the same molecule produced, using the recurrence same-molecule probability, into a new burst run of the same measurement.

analysis_folder.description: The burst run to fuse (m000.pto/<run>), or a legacy burst-analysis folder.

settings.description: FusionSettings payload: threshold, lag range, bins, max group size.

analysis_folder.description: The burst run to fuse (m000.pto/<run>), or a legacy burst-analysis folder.

detectors.description: Detector definition used to regenerate the burst columns (defaults to the source folder's reading manifest).

windows.description: PIE/micro-time windows used to regenerate the burst columns.
